_prune_cache() {
  local dir=$1
  local budget_kb=$2
  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || return 0
  local total
  total=$(du -sk "$dir" | cut -f1)
  (( total <= budget_kb )) && return 0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    local f="${line#* }"
    local sz
    sz=$(du -sk "$dir/$f" | cut -f1)
    total=$(( total - sz ))
    rm -rf "$dir/$f"
    (( total <= budget_kb )) && break
  done < <(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -n)
  return 0
}
